cosmetics.legal_hint: Cosmetics: no medical or drug claims (cure, heal, treat, clinically proven) unless listed in approved_claims. Include a short usage/ingredients notice.

toys.legal_hint: Toys: must carry an age-grading and small-parts/choking-hazard warning when the source says the set contains small parts. Never write 'safe for all ages'.

food.legal_hint: Food: only nutrition/health claims listed in approved_claims. No 'boosts immunity', 'burns fat' or similar. Include a short storage/allergen notice if the source provides one.
